question: I understand most of them, but who has written the autographs in volume 80, page 115 on the left side? - tell me who wrote them
answer: Those are of course, the five autographs given to Bartolomeo. (From left to right, top to bottom. Row One: Luffy, Zoro, Usopp (To Bartolomeo, silhouette of his profile・Usopp). Row Two: Franky (to brothers star mark FRANKY), Robin (Nico Robin, chicken picture).)
name: Please tell me who wrote them
